composition_subtypes.role: Determines max window length via binary search on answer.
Checks feasibility for a given window length by sliding min/max using monotonic queues.

payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search over window length, using amortized monotonic queues to validate if a window of that length satisfies max-min ≤ k.
payload.rationale: Binary search narrows optimal length; each check uses O(n) sliding window min/max via deques, an amortized technique. Both are essential and interleaved.
